    — autoresearch infrastructure (this folder)\n```\n\n## Model File: huggingface_rmca_v3.py\n\n### Key Classes\n- `RMCAConfig(PretrainedConfig)` — model config, inherits from HF\n- `LlamaCrossAttention(nn.Module)` — cross-attention module (Q from one source, K/V from another)\n- `MemoryAugmentedLayer(nn.Module)` — wraps a single transformer layer with memory R/W\n- `RMCACell(nn.Module)` — wraps the full model, replaces each layer with MemoryAugmentedLayer\n- `RMCAWrapperBase(nn.Module)` — processes segments, calls RMCACell per segment\n- `RMCABase(PreTrainedModel)` — top-level HF model, resets memory after each forward\n\n### Data Flow (per sample, N=2)\n1. Context segment (2 KV pairs) → all MemoryAugmentedLayers update their memory states\n2. Query+target segment → layers read from memory, compute logits\n3. Loss computed only on target tokens\n4. Memory reset in `RMCABase.forward()` after each call\n\n### MemoryAugmentedLayer.forward() detail\n```\nmemory = layer.memory_state   # (batch, num_mem_tokens, hidden_size)\n# read\nread_residual = memory_read(input_norm, memory_norm)   # hidden updates from memory\nhidden_states = hidden_states + read_residual\n# write\nwrite_residual = memory_write(memory_norm, input_norm)  # memory updates from input\nmemory = memory + write_residual\n# base layer\noutput = base_layer(hidden_states)\n```\n\n### Config Parameters (set by trainer CLI)\n| arg          | meaning                              | default |\n|--------------|--------------------------------------|---------|\n| n_layer      | number of transformer layers         | 4       |\n| n_head       | number of attention heads            | 4       |\n| n_embd       | hidden dimension                     | 128     |\n| n_mem_tokens | number of memory tokens per layer    | 8       |\n| base_model   | backbone type: llama / gpt2 / pythia | llama   |\n| n_keys       | key length in characters             | 2       |\n| n_values     | value length in characters           | 2       |\n| n_pairs      | total KV pairs = N-level             | 2       |\n\n### Evaluation\n- Primary metric: `eval_exact_match` — fraction of samples where all value tokens are correct\n- Secondary: `eval_token_accuracy` — token-level accuracy on value tokens only\n- Written to `{exp_path}/all_results.json` by `trainer.save_metrics(split=\'all\', ...)`\n\n## What NOT to Change\n- Do not modify `RMCABase.from_pretrained()` (HF loading infrastructure)\n- Do MemoryAugmentedLayer: snake_case\n- Buffer names: `initial_<thing>_state` pattern\n\n## Hyperparameter Sweeps (experiment_config.yaml)\n\nTo sweep a hyperparameter, use the `values:` format with a `default`:\n\n```yaml\nlearning_rate:\n  values: [0.0001, 0.0005, 0.001, 0.005, 0.01]\n  default: 0.01\n```\n\nSupported sweep parameters (ONE sweep per run):\n- `learning_rate` - learning rate sweep\n- `n_mem_tokens` - memory token count sweep\n\nThe sweep runs all values as separate sub-experiments and uses the best EM across all values.\nEach sub-experiment is saved in a subfolder (e.g., `iter_045_lr_0_0`, `iter_045_lr_0_1`, etc.).\n\nExample for learning rate sweep:\n```yaml\nlearning_rate:\n  values: [0.0001, 0.001, 0.01]\n  default: 0.01\n```\n\nExample for memory token sweep:\n```yaml\nn_mem_tokens:\n  values: [8, 16, 32, 64]\n  default: 32\n```\n\n\n## Current Model Architecture (modeling_rmt/huggingface_rmca_v3.py)\nimport math\nimport torch\nimport torch.nn as nn\nimport torch.nn.functional as F\nfrom torch.nn import CrossEntropyLoss\n\nfrom transformers import StoppingCriteria\nfrom transformers import PreTrainedModel, PretrainedConfig\nfrom transformers.modeling_outputs import CausalLMOutputWithCrossAttentions\n\n\nclass RMCAConfig(PretrainedConfig):\n    model_type = "rmt"\n\n    def __init__(self,\n                 base_model_name="HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-135M",\n                 base_model_config=None,\n                 from_pretrained=None,\n                 num_mem_tokens=16,\n                 max_n_segments=10,\n                 think_token_id=None,\n                 answer_token_id=None,\n                 bos_token_id=None,\n                 eos_token_id=None,\n                 num_mem_heads=8,\n                 use_deep_supervision=False,\n                 deep_supervision_weight=0.1,\n                 deep_supervision_layers=None,\n                 use_segment_curriculum=False,\n                 curriculum_start_ratio=0.5,\n                 curriculum_steps=10000,\n                 **kwargs):\n        super().__init__(**kwargs)\n        self.base_model_name = base_model_name\n        self.base_model_config = base_model_config\n        self.from_pretrained = from_pretrained\n        self.num_mem_tokens = num_mem_tokens\n        self.max_n_segments = max_n_segments\n        self.think_token_id = think_token_id\n        self.answer_token_id = answer_token_id\n        self.bos_token_id = bos_token_id\n        self.eos_token_id = eos_token_id\n        self.memory_cell_cls = "RMCACell"\n        self.recurrent_wrapper_cls = "RMCAWrapperNoSegmentation"\n        self.use_deep_supervision = use_deep_supervision\n        self.deep_supervision_weight = deep_supervision_weight\n        self.deep_supervision_layers = deep_supervision_layers\n        self.use_segment_curriculum = use_segment_curriculum\n        self.curriculum_start_ratio = curriculum_start_ratio\n        self.curriculum_steps = curriculum_steps\n\n    def get(self, attr: str, default=None):\n        if hasattr(self, attr):\n            return getattr(self, attr)\n        else:\n            return default\n\n\nfrom transformers.models.llama.modeling_llama import apply_rotary_pos_emb\n\n\nclass LlamaCrossAttention(nn.Module):\n    """Cross-attention with same structure as Llama (q/k/v/o, optional RoPE). Returns (attn_output, attn_weights).\n\n    Differences from original Llama self-attention (LlamaAttention):\n    - Cross-attention: Q from from_states, K/V from to_states (no past_key_values/cache).\n    - Init from explicit args (hidden_size, num_heads, ...) instead of LlamaConfig and layer_idx.\n    - Optional RoPE: position_embeddings is (cos_q, sin_q, cos_k, sin_k) for query/key positions; when None, no RoPE.\n    - No causal mask or attention_implementation: plain scaled dot-product attention.\n    - Always returns (output, attn_weights); attn_weights may be used for output_attentions.\n    """\n\n    def __init__(\n        self,\n        hidden_size: int,\n        num_heads: int,\n        head_dim: int | None = None,\n        num_key_value_heads: int | None = None,\n        dropout: float = 0.0,\n        bias: bool = False,\n    ):\n        super().__init__()\n        self.hidden_size = hidden_size\n        self.num_heads = num_heads\n        self.head_dim = head_dim if head_dim is not None else hidden_size // num_heads\n        self.num_key_value_heads = num_key_value_heads if num_key_value_heads is not None else num_heads\n        self.num_key_value_groups = num_heads // self.num_key_value_heads\n        self.scaling = self.head_dim**-0.5\n        self.attention_dropout = dropout\n\n        self.q_proj = nn.Linear(hidden_size, num_heads * self.head_dim, bias=bias)\n        self.k_proj = nn.Linear(hidden_size, self.num_key_value_heads * self.head_dim, bias=bias)\n        self.v_proj = nn.Linear(hidden_size, self.num_key_value_heads * self.head_dim, bias=bias)\n        self.o_proj = nn.Linear(num_heads * self.head_dim, hidden_size, bias=bias)\n\n    def forward(\n        self,\n        from_states: torch.Tensor,\n        to_states: torch.Tensor,\n        position_embeddings: tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor] | None = None,\n        attention_mask: torch.Tensor | None = None,\n    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor | None]:\n        batch_size, q_len, _ = from_states.shape\n        k_len = to_states.shape[1]\n        input_shape = from_states.shape[:-1]\n        q_hidden_shape = (*input_shape, -1, self.head_dim)\n        kv_hidden_shape = (batch_size, k_len, -1, self.head_dim)\n\n        query_states = self.q_proj(from_states).view(q_hidden_shape).transpose(1, 2)\n        key_states = self.k_proj(to_states).view(kv_hidden_shape).transpose(1, 2)\n        value_states = self.v_proj(to_states).view(kv_hidden_shape).transpose(1, 2)\n\n        if position_embeddings is not None:\n            cos_q, sin_q, cos_k, sin_k = position_embeddings\n            query_states, _ = apply_rotary_pos_emb(query_states, query_states, cos_q, sin_q)\n            _, key_states = apply_rotary_pos_emb(key_states, key_states, cos_k, sin_k)\n\n        if self.num_key_value_groups > 1:\n            key_states = key_states.repeat_interleave(self.num_key_value_groups, dim=1)\n            value_states = value_states.repeat_interleave(self.num_key_value_groups, dim=1)\n\n        attn_weights = torch.matmul(query_states, key_states.transpose(-2, -1)) * self.scaling\n        if attention_mask is not None:\n            attn_weights = attn_weights + attention_mask\n        attn_weights = F.softmax(attn_weights, dim=-1, dtype=torch.float32).to(query_states.dtype)\n        attn_weights = F.dropout(\n            attn_weights, p=self.attention_dropout if self.training else 0.0, training=self.training\n        )\n\n        attn_output = torch.matmul(attn_weights, value_states)\n        attn_output = attn_output.transpose(1, 2).reshape(*input_shape, -1).contiguous()\n        return self.o_proj(attn_output), attn_weights\n\n\nclass MemoryAugmentedLayer(nn.Module):\n    """Wraps a transformer layer with memory read/write via cross-attention"""\n    def __init__(self, base_layer, memory_read_layer, memory_write_layer, initial_memory_state, config=None):\n        super().__init__()\n        self.base_layer = base_layer\n        self.memory_read = memory_read_layer\n        self.memory_write = memory_write_layer\n        self.register_buffer(\'initial_memory_state\', initial_memory_state)\n        self.memory_state = initial_memory_state\n\n        self.memory_layer_norm = torch.nn.RMSNorm(initial_memory_state.shape[-1])\n        self.input_layer_norm = torch.nn.RMSNorm(initial_memory_state.shape[-1])\n        self.pre_base_layer_norm = torch.nn.RMSNorm(initial_memory_state.shape[-1])\n        self.post_base_layer_norm = torch.nn.RMSNorm(initial_memory_state.shape[-1])\n        self.memory_dropout = torch.nn.Dropout(config.get(\'memory_dropout\', 0.0) if config else 0.0)\n        self.write_gate = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(1))\n        self.read_gate = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(1))\n        self.write_scale = nn.Parameter(torch.tensor(0.5))\n    \n    def forward(self, hidden_states, *args, **kwargs):\n        batch_size = hidden_states.shape[0]\n        if self.memory_state.shape[0] != batch_size:\n            memory = self.initial_memory_state.expand(batch_size, -1, -1).to(hidden_states.device)\n        else:\n            memory = self.memory_state.to(hidden_states.device)\n        \n        # Read from memory\n        memory_normed = self.memory_layer_norm(memory)\n        hidden_states_normed = self.input_layer_norm(hidden_states)\n        \n        read_out = self.memory_read(hidden_states_normed, memory_normed)\n        read_residual = read_out[0] if isinstance(read_out, tuple) else read_out\n        read_attn_weights = read_out[1] if isinstance(read_out, tuple) and len(read_out) > 1 else None\n        read_residual = self.memory_dropout(read_residual)\n        hidden_states = hidden_states + (self.read_gate * read_residual)\n\n        # Write to memory\n        write_out = self.memory_write(memory_normed, hidden_states_normed)\n        write_residual = write_out[0] if isinstance(write_out, tuple) else write_out\n        write_attn_weights = write_out[1] if isinstance(write_out, tuple) and len(write_out) > 1 else None\n        write_residual = self.memory_layer_norm(write_residual)\n        write_residual = self.memory_dropout(write_residual)\n        memory = memory + self.write_scale * (self.write_gate * write_residual)\n        self.memory_state = memory\n\n        # Base layer forward\n        # hidden_states = self.pre_base_layer_norm(hidden_states)\n        output = self.base_layer(hidden_states, *args, **kwargs)\n        # hidden_states = hidden_states + (output[0] if isinstance(output, tuple) else output)\n        hidden_states = output[0] if isinstance(output, tuple) else output\n\n        # Pass through base layer outputs (hidden_states, cache?, attentions?) and append cross-attention weights\n        if isinstance(output, tuple):\n            cross_attentions = (read_attn_weights, write_attn_weights)\n            return (hidden_states,) + output[1:] + (cross_attentions,)\n        return hidden_states\n    \n    def reset_memory(self):\n        self.memory_state = self.initial_memory_state\n\n\nclass RMCACell(torch.nn.Module):\n    def __init__(self, base_model, num_mem_tokens, num_heads=8):\n        super().__init__()\n        self.model = base_model\n        self.num_mem_tokens = num_mem_tokens\n\n        hidden_size = getattr(base_model.config, "n_embd", base_model.config.hidden_size)\n        num_attention_heads = getattr(base_model.config, "num_attention_heads", num_heads)\n        num_key_value_heads = getattr(base_model.config, "num_key_value_heads", num_attention_heads)\n        head_dim = getattr(base_model.config, "head_dim", hidden_size // num_attention_heads)\n        attention_dropout = getattr(base_model.config, "attention_dropout", 0.0)\n        attention_bias = getattr(base_model.config, "attention_bias", False)\n\n        model_dtype = next(base_model.parameters()).dtype\n        model_device = next(base_model.parameters()).device\n        for i, layer in enumerate(self.model.model.layers):\n            memory_read = LlamaCrossAttention(\n                hidden_size=hidden_size,\n                num_heads=num_attention_heads,\n                head_dim=head_dim,\n                num_key_value_heads=num_key_value_heads,\n                dropout=attention_dropout,\n                bias=attention_bias,\n            ).to(dtype=model_dtype, device=model_device)\n            memory_write = LlamaCrossAttention(\n                hidden_size=hidden_size,\n                num_heads=num_attention_heads,\n                head_dim=head_dim,\n                num_key_value_heads=num_key_value_heads,\n                dropout=attention_dropout,\n                bias=attention_bias,\n            ).to(dtype=model_dtype, device=model_device)\n            # initial_memory = self.memory.unsqueeze(0).to(dtype=model_dtype, device=model_device)\n            initial_memory = torch.randn(1, num_mem_tokens, hidden_size) / math.sqrt(hidden_size)\n            wrapped_layer = MemoryAugmentedLayer(\n                layer.to(dtype=model_dtype, device=model_device),\n                memory_read.to(dtype=model_dtype, device=model_device),\n                memory_write.to(dtype=model_dtype, device=model_device),\n                initial_memory.to(dtype=model_dtype, device=model_device)\n            )\n            self.model.model.layers[i] = wrapped_layer\n\n    def forward(self, input_ids, **kwargs):\n        out = self.model(input_ids=input_ids, **kwargs)\n        # memory_state = [layer.memory_state for layer in self.model.model.layers]\n        return out\n\n    def generate(self, input_ids, **kwargs):\n        return self.model.generate(input_ids=input_ids, **kwargs)\n\n\nclass RMCAWrapperBase(torch.nn.Module):\n    def __init__(self, memory_cell, **rmt_kwargs):\n        super().__init__()\n        self.memory_cell = memory_cell\n        self.rmt_config = rmt_kwargs\n        self._global_step = 0\n\n    def get_curriculum_mask(self, seq_len):\n        """Compute effective length mask for segment-length curriculum.\n        \n        During early training, gradually expand the effective attention scope from\n        curriculum_start_ratio to 1.0 over curriculum_steps.\n        \n        Args:\n            seq_len: Total sequence length\n            \n        Returns:\n            Tensor of shape (1, seq_len) with 1s for valid positions and 0s for masked positions\n        """\n        use_curriculum = self.rmt_config.get(\'use_segment_curriculum\', False)\n        if not use_curriculum:\n            return None\n        \n        curriculum_start_ratio = self.rmt_config.get(\'curriculum_start_ratio\', 0.5)\n        curriculum_steps = self.rmt_config.get(\'curriculum_steps\', 10000)\n        \n        # Compute current progress (0 to 1)\n        progress = min(self._global_step / curriculum_steps, 1.0)\n        \n        # Current effective ratio: starts at curriculum_start_ratio, grows to 1.0\n        current_ratio = curriculum_start_ratio + progress * (1.0 - curriculum_start_ratio)\n        \n        # Compute number of tokens to keep\n        effective_len = int(current_ratio * seq_len)\n        \n        # Create mask: 1s for first effective_len tokens, 0s for rest\n        mask = torch.zeros(1, seq_len, device=self.rmt_config.get(\'device\', \'cpu\'))\n        mask[0, :effective_len] = 1.0\n        \n        return mask\n    \n    def forward(self, segments, labels, output_attentions=None, output_hidden_states=None, *args, **kwargs):\n        # Update global step for curriculum computation\n        self._global_step += 1\n        \n        cell_outputs = []\n        for seg_num, segment in enumerate(segments):\n            cell_out = self.memory_cell(input_ids=segment[\'input_ids\'],\n                                        attention_mask=segment[\'attention_mask\'],\n                                        output_hidden_states=True)\n            cell_outputs.append(cell_out)\n\n        # Extract labels_mask from segments if available\n        labels_mask = None\n        if \'labels_mask\' in segments[0]:\n            labels_mask = torch.cat([seg[\'labels_mask\'] for seg in segments], dim=1)\n\n        # Compute curriculum mask if enabled\n        curriculum_mask = None\n        if self.rmt_config.get(\'use_segment_curriculum\', False):\n            total_seq_len = sum(seg[\'input_ids\'].shape[1] for seg in segments)\n            curriculum_mask = self.get_curriculum_mask(total_seq_len)\n\n        out = self.process_outputs(cell_outputs,\n                                   labels=labels,\n                                   labels_mask=labels_mask,\n                                   output_attentions=output_attentions,\n                                   output_hidden_states=output_hidden_states,\n                                   curriculum_mask=curriculum_mask,\n                                   **kwargs\n                                   )\n        return out\n\n    def generate(self, segments, **kwargs):\n        raise NotImplementedError("Generation is not implemented for RMCAWrapperBase")\n\n    def generate_segment(self, memory_state, **kwargs):\n        raise NotImplementedError("Generation is not implemented for RMCAWrapperBase")\n\n    def process_outputs(self, cell_outputs, **kwargs):\n        out = CausalLMOutputWithCrossAttentions()\n        full_logits = torch.cat([o.logits for o in cell_outputs], dim=1)\n        full_hidden_states = tuple([torch.cat(layer_hs, dim=1)\n                                    for layer_hs in zip(*[o.hidden_states for o in cell_outputs])])\n\n        labels = kwargs.get(\'labels\')\n        loss_fct = CrossEntropyLoss()\n        \n        # Main loss computation\n        if labels is not None:\n            shift_labels = labels[..., 1:].contiguous()\n            shift_logits = full_logits[..., :-1, :].contiguous()\n            flat_labels = shift_labels.view(-1)\n            flat_logits = shift_logits.view(-1, shift_logits.size(-1))\n\n            labels_mask = kwargs.get(\'labels_mask\')\n            curriculum_mask = kwargs.get(\'curriculum_mask\')\n            \n            if labels_mask is not None:\n                shift_mask = labels_mask[..., :-1].contiguous()\n                flat_labels = flat_labels[shift_mask.view(-1)]\n                flat_logits = flat_logits[shift_mask.view(-1)]\n            \n            # Apply curriculum mask to limit attention scope\n            if curriculum_mask is not None:\n                curriculum_mask_expanded = curriculum_mask[..., :-1].contiguous()\n                if labels_mask is None:\n                    flat_labels = flat_labels[curriculum_mask_expanded.view(-1)]\n                    flat_logits = flat_logits[curriculum_mask_expanded.view(-1)]\n                else:\n                    combined_mask = shift_mask * curriculum_mask_expanded\n                    flat_labels = flat_labels[combined_mask.view(-1)]\n                    flat_logits = flat_logits[combined_mask.view(-1)]\n\n            main_loss = loss_fct(flat_logits, flat_labels)\n        else:\n            main_loss = torch.tensor(0.0, device=full_logits.device)\n\n        # Deep supervision loss computation\n        use_deep_supervision = self.rmt_config.get(\'use_deep_supervision\', False)\n        deep_supervision_layers = self.rmt_config.get(\'deep_supervision_layers\', None)\n        deep_supervision_weight = self.rmt_config.get(\'deep_supervision_weight\', 0.1)\n        \n        if use_deep_supervision and deep_supervision_layers is not None and labels is not None:\n            deep_supervision_loss = 0.0\n            n_layers = len(full_hidden_states)\n            \n            for layer_idx in deep_supervision_layers:\n                if 0 <= layer_idx < n_layers:\n                    layer_hidden_states = full_hidden_states[layer_idx]\n                    # Apply layer norm to hidden states before computing logits\n                    # The hidden states need to be projected to vocab space\n                    # Use the final layer\'s lm_head for consistency\n                    # For simplicity, compute loss on intermediate hidden states\n transformers.models.llama.modeling_llama import apply_rotary_pos_emb\\\\n\\\\n\\\\nclass LlamaCrossAttention(nn.Module):\\\\n    """Cross-attention with same structure as Llama (q/k/v/o, optional RoPE). Returns (attn_output, attn_weights).\\\\n\\\\n    Differences from original Llama self-attention (LlamaAttention):\\\\n    - Cross-attention: Q from from_states, K/V from to_states (no past_key_values/cache).\\\\n    - Init from explicit args (hidden_size, num_heads, ...) instead of LlamaConfig and layer_idx.\\\\n    - Optional RoPE: position_embeddings is (cos_q, sin_q, cos_k, sin_k) for query/key positions; when None, no RoPE.\\\\n    - No causal mask or attention_implementation: plain scaled dot-product attention.\\\\n    - Always returns (output, attn_weights); attn_weights may be used for output_attentions.\\\\n    """\\\\n\\\\n    def __init__(\\\\n        self,\\\\n        hidden_size: int,\\\\n        num_heads: int,\\\\n        head_dim: int | None = None,\\\\n        num_key_value_heads: int | None = None,\\\\n        dropout: float = 0.0,\\\\n        bias: bool = False,\\\\n    ):\\\\n        super().__init__()\\\\n        self.hidden_size = hidden_size\\\\n        self.num_heads = num_heads\\\\n        self.head_dim = head_dim if head_dim is not None else hidden_size // num_heads\\\\n        self.num_key_value_heads = num_key_value_heads if num_key_value_heads is not None else num_heads\\\\n        self.num_key_value_groups = num_heads // self.num_key_value_heads\\\\n        self.scaling = self.head_dim**-0.5\\\\n        self.attention_dropout = dropout\\\\n\\\\n        self.q_proj = nn.Linear(hidden_size, num_heads * self.head_dim, bias=bias)\\\\n        self.k_proj = nn.Linear(hidden_size, self.num_key_value_heads * self.head_dim, bias=bias)\\\\n        self.v_proj = nn.Linear(hidden_size, self.num_key_value_heads * self.head_dim, bias=bias)\\\\n        self.o_proj = nn.Linear(num_heads * self.head_dim, hidden_size, bias=bias)\\\\n\\\\n    def forward(\\\\n        self,\\\\n        from_states: torch.Tensor,\\\\n        to_states: torch.Tensor,\\\\n        position_embeddings: tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor] | None = None,\\\\n        attention_mask: torch.Tensor | None = None,\\\\n    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor | None]:\\\\n        batch_size, q_len, _ = from_states.shape\\\\n        k_len = to_states.shape[1]\\\\n        input_shape = from_states.shape[:-1]\\\\n        q_hidden_shape = (*input_shape, -1, self.head_dim)\\\\n        kv_hidden_shape = (batch_size, k_len, -1, self.head_dim)\\\\n\\\\n        query_states = self.q_proj(from_states).view(q_hidden_shape).transpose(1, 2)\\\\n        key_states = self.k_proj(to_states).view(kv_hidden_shape).transpose(1, 2)\\\\n        value_states = self.v_proj(to_states).view(kv_hidden_shape).transpose(1, 2)\\\\n\\\\n        if position_embeddings is not None:\\\\n            cos_q, sin_q, cos_k, sin_k = position_embeddings\\\\n            query_states, _ = apply_rotary_pos_emb(query_states, query_states, cos_q, sin_q)\\\\n            _, key_states = apply_rotary_pos_emb(key_states, key_states, cos_k, sin_k)\\\\n\\\\n        if self.num_key_value_groups > 1:\\\\n            key_states = key_states.repeat_interleave(self.num_key_value_groups, dim=1)\\\\n            value_states = value_states.repeat_interleave(self.num_key_value_groups, dim=1)\\\\n\\\\n        attn_weights = torch.matmul(query_states, key_states.transpose(-2, -1)) * self.scaling\\\\n        if attention_mask is not None:\\\\n            attn_weights = attn_weights + attention_mask\\\\n        attn_weights = F.softmax(attn_weights, dim=-1, dtype=torch.float32).to(query_states.dtype)\\\\n        attn_weights = F.dropout(\\\\n            attn_weights, p=self.attention_dropout if self.training else 0.0, training=self.training\\\\n        )\\\\n\\\\n        attn_output = torch.matmul(attn_weights, value_states)\\\\n        attn_output = attn_output.transpose(1, 2).reshape(*input_shape, -1).contiguous()\\\\n        return self.o_proj(attn_output), attn_weights\\\\n\\\\n\\\\nclass MemoryAugmentedLayer(nn.Module):\\\\n    """Wraps a transformer layer with memory read/write via cross-attention"""\\\\n    def self.memory_read = memory_read_layer\\\\n        self.memory_write = memory_write_layer\\\\n        self.register_buffer(\\\\\\\'initial_memory_state\\\\\\\', initial_memory_state)\\\\n        self.memory_state = initial_memory_state\\\\n\\\\n        self.memory_layer_norm = torch.nn.RMSNorm(initial_memory_state.shape[-1])\\\\n        self.input_layer_norm = torch.nn.RMSNorm(initial_memory_state.shape[-1])\\\\n        self.pre_base_layer_norm = torch.nn.RMSNorm(initial_memory_state.shape[-1])\\\\n        self.post_base_layer_norm = torch.nn.RMSNorm(initial_memory_state.shape[-1])\\\\n        self.memory_dropout = torch.nn.Dropout(config.get(\\\\\\\'memory_dropout\\\\\\\', 0.0) if config else 0.0)\\\\n        self.write_gate = *args, **kwargs):\\\\n        batch_size = hidden_states.shape[0]\\\\n        if self.memory_state.shape[0] != batch_size:\\\\n            memory = self.initial_memory_state.expand(batch_size, -1, self.memory_layer_norm(memory)\\\\n        hidden_states_normed = self.input_layer_norm(hidden_states)\\\\n        \\\\n        read_out = self.memory_read(hidden_states_normed, memory_normed)\\\\n read_residual = self.memory_dropout(read_residual)\\\\n        hidden_states = hidden_states + (self.read_gate * read_residual)\\\\n\\\\n        # Write to memory\\\\n        write_out = isinstance(write_out, tuple) and len(write_out) > 1 else None\\\\n        write_residual = self.memory_layer_norm(write_residual)\\\\n        write_residual = self.memory_dropout(write_residual)\\\\n self.pre_base_layer_norm(hidden_states)\\\\n        output = self.base_layer(hidden_states, *args, **kwargs)\\\\n        # hidden_states = hidden_states + (output[0] if isinstance(output, tuple) else (cross_attentions,)\\\\n        return hidden_states\\\\n    \\\\n    def reset_memory(self):\\\\n        self.memory_state = self.initial_memory_state\\\\n\\\\n\\\\nclass progress (0 to 1)\\\\n        progress = min(self._global_step / curriculum_steps, 1.0)\\\\n        \\\\n        # Current effective ratio: starts at curriculum_start_ratio, grows to 1.0\\\\n transformers.models.llama.modeling_llama import apply_rotary_pos_emb\\n\\n\\nclass LlamaCrossAttention(nn.Module):\\n    """Cross-attention with same structure as Llama (q/k/v/o, optional RoPE). Returns (attn_output, attn_weights).\\n\\n    Differences from original Llama self-attention (LlamaAttention):\\n    - Cross-attention: Q from from_states, K/V from to_states (no past_key_values/cache).\\n    - Init from explicit args (hidden_size, num_heads, ...) instead of LlamaConfig and layer_idx.\\n    - Optional RoPE: position_embeddings is (cos_q, sin_q, cos_k, sin_k) for query/key positions; when None, no RoPE.\\n    - No causal mask or attention_implementation: plain scaled dot-product attention.\\n    - Always returns (output, attn_weights); attn_weights may be used for output_attentions.\\n    """\\n\\n    def __init__(\\n        self,\\n        hidden_size: int,\\n        num_heads: int,\\n        head_dim: int | None = None,\\n        num_key_value_heads: int | None = None,\\n        dropout: float = 0.0,\\n        bias: bool = False,\\n    ):\\n        super().__init__()\\n        self.hidden_size = hidden_size\\n        self.num_heads = num_heads\\n        self.head_dim = head_dim if head_dim is not None else hidden_size // num_heads\\n        self.num_key_value_heads = num_key_value_heads if num_key_value_heads is not None else num_heads\\n        self.num_key_value_groups = num_heads // self.num_key_value_heads\\n        self.scaling = self.head_dim**-0.5\\n        self.attention_dropout = dropout\\n\\n        self.q_proj = nn.Linear(hidden_size, num_heads * self.head_dim, bias=bias)\\n        self.k_proj = nn.Linear(hidden_size, self.num_key_value_heads * self.head_dim, bias=bias)\\n        self.v_proj = nn.Linear(hidden_size, self.num_key_value_heads * self.head_dim, bias=bias)\\n        self.o_proj = nn.Linear(num_heads * self.head_dim, hidden_size, bias=bias)\\n\\n    def forward(\\n        self,\\n        from_states: torch.Tensor,\\n        to_states: torch.Tensor,\\n        position_embeddings: tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor] | None = None,\\n        attention_mask: torch.Tensor | None = None,\\n    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor | None]:\\n        batch_size, q_len, _ = from_states.shape\\n        k_len = to_states.shape[1]\\n        input_shape = from_states.shape[:-1]\\n        q_hidden_shape = (*input_shape, -1, self.head_dim)\\n        kv_hidden_shape = (batch_size, k_len, -1, self.head_dim)\\n\\n        query_states = self.q_proj(from_states).view(q_hidden_shape).transpose(1, 2)\\n        key_states = self.k_proj(to_states).view(kv_hidden_shape).transpose(1, 2)\\n        value_states = self.v_proj(to_states).view(kv_hidden_shape).transpose(1, 2)\\n\\n        if position_embeddings is not None:\\n            cos_q, sin_q, cos_k, sin_k = position_embeddings\\n            query_states, 1:\\n            key_states = key_states.repeat_interleave(self.num_key_value_groups, dim=1)\\n            value_states = value_states.repeat_interleave(self.num_key_value_groups, dim=1)\\n\\n    return hidden_states\\n    \\n    def reset_memory(self):\\n        self.memory_state = self.initial_memory_state\\n\\n\\nclass RMCACell(torch.nn.Module):\\n    def __init__(self, base_model, """Cross-attention with same structure as Llama (q/k/v/o, optional RoPE). None,\n        dropout: float = 0.0,\n        bias: bool = False,\n    ):\n        super().__init__()\n        self.hidden_size = hidden_size\n        self.num_heads = num_heads\n        self.head_dim = head_dim if head_dim is not None else hidden_size // num_heads\n        self.num_key_value_heads = num_key_value_heads if num_key_value_heads is not None else num_heads\n        self.num_key_value_groups = num_heads // self.num_key_value_heads\n        self.scaling = self.head_dim**-0.5\n        self.attention_dropout = dropout\n\n        self.q_proj = nn.Linear(hidden_size, = None,\n    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor | None]:\n        batch_size, q_len, _ = from_states.shape\n        k_len = to_states.shape[1]\n        input_shape = from_states.shape[:-1]\n        q_hidden_shape = (*input_shape, -1, self.head_dim)\n        kv_hidden_shape = (batch_size, k_len, -1, self.head_dim)\n\n        query_states = self.q_proj(from_states).view(q_hidden_shape).transpose(1, 2)\n        key_states = self.k_proj(to_states).view(kv_hidden_shape).transpose(1, 2)\n        value_states = self.v_proj(to_states).view(kv_hidden_shape).transpose(1, 2)\n\n        if position_embeddings is not None:\n            cos_q, sin_q, cos_k, sin_k = position_embeddings\n            query_states, _ = transformers.models.llama.modeling_llama import apply_rotary_pos_emb\\\\n\\\\n\\\\nclass LlamaCrossAttention(nn.Module):\\\\n    """Cross-attention with same structure as Llama (q/k/v/o, optional RoPE). Returns (attn_output, attn_weights).\\\\n\\\\n    Differences from original Llama self-attention (LlamaAttention):\\\\n    - Cross-attention: Q from from_states, K/V from to_states (no past_key_values/cache).\\\\n    - Init from explicit args (hidden_size, num_heads, ...) instead of LlamaConfig and layer_idx.\\\\n    - Optional RoPE: position_embeddings is (cos_q, sin_q, cos_k, sin_k) for query/key positions; when None, no RoPE.\\\\n    - No causal mask or attention_implementation: plain scaled dot-product attention.\\\\n    - Always returns (output, attn_weights); attn_weights may be used for output_attentions.\\\\n    """\\\\n\\\\n    def __init__(\\\\n        self,\\\\n        hidden_size: int,\\\\n        num_heads: int,\\\\n        head_dim: int | None = None,\\\\n        num_key_value_heads: int | None = None,\\\\n        dropout: float = 0.0,\\\\n        bias: bool = False,\\\\n    ):\\\\n        super().__init__()\\\\n        self.hidden_size = hidden_size\\\\n        self.num_heads = num_heads\\\\n        self.head_dim = head_dim if head_dim is not None else hidden_size // num_heads\\\\n        self.num_key_value_heads = num_key_value_heads if num_key_value_heads is not None else num_heads\\\\n        self.num_key_value_groups = num_heads // self.num_key_value_heads\\\\n        self.scaling = self.head_dim**-0.5\\\\n        self.attention_dropout = dropout\\\\n\\\\n        self.q_proj = nn.Linear(hidden_size, num_heads * self.head_dim, bias=bias)\\\\n        self.k_proj = nn.Linear(hidden_size, self.num_key_value_heads * self.head_dim, bias=bias)\\\\n        self.v_proj = nn.Linear(hidden_size, self.num_key_value_heads * self.head_dim, bias=bias)\\\\n        self.o_proj = nn.Linear(num_heads * self.head_dim, hidden_size, bias=bias)\\\\n\\\\n    def forward(\\\\n        self,\\\\n        from_states: torch.Tensor,\\\\n        to_states: torch.Tensor,\\\\n        position_embeddings: tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor] | None = None,\\\\n        attention_mask: torch.Tensor | None = None,\\\\n    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor | None]:\\\\n        batch_size, q_len, _ = from_states.shape\\\\n        k_len = to_states.shape[1]\\\\n        input_shape = from_states.shape[:-1]\\\\n        q_hidden_shape = (*input_shape, -1, self.head_dim)\\\\n        kv_hidden_shape = (batch_size, k_len, -1, self.head_dim)\\\\n\\\\n        query_states = self.q_proj(from_states).view(q_hidden_shape).transpose(1, 2)\\\\n        key_states = self.k_proj(to_states).view(kv_hidden_shape).transpose(1, 2)\\\\n        value_states = self.v_proj(to_states).view(kv_hidden_shape).transpose(1, 2)\\\\n\\\\n        if position_embeddings is not None:\\\\n            cos_q, sin_q, cos_k, sin_k = position_embeddings\\\\n            query_states, _ = apply_rotary_pos_emb(query_states, query_states, cos_q, sin_q)\\\\n            _, key_states = apply_rotary_pos_emb(key_states, key_states, cos_k, sin_k)\\\\n\\\\n        if self.num_key_value_groups > 1:\\\\n            key_states = key_states.repeat_interleave(self.num_key_value_groups, dim=1)\\\\n            value_states = value_states.repeat_interleave(self.num_key_value_groups, dim=1)\\\\n\\\\n        attn_weights = torch.matmul(query_states, key_states.transpose(-2, -1)) * self.scaling\\\\n        if attention_mask is not None:\\\\n            attn_weights = attn_weights + attention_mask\\\\n        attn_weights = F.softmax(attn_weights, dim=-1, )\\\\n\\\\n        attn_output = torch.matmul(attn_weights, value_states)\\\\n        attn_output = attn_output.transpose(1, 2).reshape(*input_shape, -1).contiguous()\\\\n        return Memory reset in `RMCABase.forward()` after each call\n\n### MemoryAugmentedLayer.forward() detail\n```\nmemory = layer.memory_state   # (batch, num_mem_tokens, hidden_size)\n# read\nread_residual = memory_read(input_norm, memory_norm)   # hidden updates from memory\nhidden_states = hidden_states + read_residual\n# write\nwrite_residual = memory_write(memory_norm, input_norm)  # memory updates from input\nmemory = memory + write_residual\n# base layer\noutput = base_layer(hidden_states)\n```\n\n### Config Parameters (set by trainer CLI)\n| arg          | meaning                              | default |\n|--------------|--------------------------------------|---------|\n| n_layer      | number of transformer layers         | 4       |\n| n_head       | number of attention heads            | 4       |\n| n_embd       | hidden dimension                     | 128     |\n| n_mem_tokens | number of memory tokens per layer    | 8       |\n| base_model   | backbone type: llama / gpt2 / pythia | llama   |\n| n_keys       | key length in characters             | 2       |\n| n_values     | value length in characters           | 2       |\n| n_pairs      | total KV pairs = N-level             | 2       |\n\n### Evaluation\n- Primary metric: `eval_exact_match` — fraction of samples where all value tokens are correct\n- Secondary: `eval_token_accuracy` — token-level accuracy on value tokens only\n- Written to `{exp_path}/all_results.json` by `trainer.save_metrics(split=\'all\', ...)`\n\n## What NOT to Change\n- Do not modify `RMCABase.from_pretrained()` (HF loading infrastructure)\n- Do not change class names or constructor signatures of `RMCABase`, `RMCAConfig`\n  (the trainer instantiates these by name)\n- Do not add new CLI arguments without also updating `run_rmca_on_kv_retrieval-v3.py`\n\n## Naming Conventions\n- New helper classes: PascalCase, suffix with purpose (e.g. `MemoryGate`, `CrossLayerSkip`)\n- New nn.Module attributes in MemoryAugmentedLayer: snake_case\n- Buffer names: `initial_<thing>_state` pattern\n\n## Hyperparameter Sweeps (experiment_config.yaml)\n\nTo sweep a hyperparameter, use the `values:` format with a `default`:\n\n```yaml\nlearning_rate:\n  values: [0.0001, 0.0005, 0.001, 0.005, 0.01]\n  default: 0.01\n```\n\nSupported sweep parameters (ONE sweep per run):\n- `learning_rate` - learning rate sweep\n- `n_mem_tokens` - memory token count sweep\n\nThe sweep runs all values as separate sub-experiments and uses the best EM across all values.\nEach sub-experiment is saved in a subfolder (e.g., `iter_045_lr_0_0`, `iter_045_lr_0_1`, etc.).\n\nExample for learning rate sweep:\n```yaml\nlearning_rate:\n  values: [0.0001, 0.001, 0.01]\n  default: 0.01\n```\n\nExample for memory token sweep:\n```yaml\nn_mem_tokens:\n  values: [8, 16, 32, 64]\n  default: 32\n```\n\n\n## Current Model Architecture (modeling_rmt/huggingface_rmca_v3.py)\nimport math\nimport torch\nimport torch.nn as nn\nimport torch.nn.functional as F\nfrom torch.nn import CrossEntropyLoss\n\nfrom transformers import StoppingCriteria\nfrom transformers import PreTrainedModel, PretrainedConfig\nfrom transformers.modeling_outputs import CausalLMOutputWithCrossAttentions\n\n\nclass RMCAConfig(PretrainedConfig):\n    model_type = "rmt"\n\n    def __init__(self,\n                 base_model_name="HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-135M",\n                 base_model_config=None,\n                 from_pretrained=None,\n                 num_mem_tokens=16,\n                 max_n_segments=10,\n                 think_token_id=None,\n                 answer_token_id=None,\n                 bos_token_id=None,\n                 eos_token_id=None,\n                 num_mem_heads=8,\n                 use_deep_supervision=False,\n                 deep_supervision_weight=0.1,\n                 deep_supervision_layers=None,\n                 use_segment_curriculum=False,\n                 curriculum_start_ratio=0.5,\n                 curriculum_steps=10000,\n                 **kwargs):\n        super().__init__(**kwargs)\n        self.base_model_name = base_model_name\n        self.base_model_config = base_model_config\n        self.from_pretrained = from_pretrained\n        self.num_mem_tokens = num_mem_tokens\n        self.max_n_segments = max_n_segments\n        self.think_token_id = think_token_id\n        self.answer_token_id = answer_token_id\n        self.bos_token_id = bos_token_id\n        self.eos_token_id = eos_token_id\n        self.memory_cell_cls = "RMCACell"\n        self.recurrent_wrapper_cls = "RMCAWrapperNoSegmentation"\n        self.use_deep_supervision = use_deep_supervision\n        self.deep_supervision_weight = deep_supervision_weight\n        self.deep_supervision_layers = deep_supervision_layers\n        self.use_segment_curriculum = use_segment_curriculum\n        self.curriculum_start_ratio = curriculum_start_ratio\n        self.curriculum_steps = curriculum_steps\n\n    def get(self, attr: str, default=None):\n        if hasattr(self, attr):\n            return getattr(self, attr)\n        else:\n            return default\n\n\nfrom transformers.models.llama.modeling_llama import apply_rotary_pos_emb\n\n\nclass LlamaCrossAttention(nn.Module):\n    """Cross-attention with same structure as Llama (q/k/v/o, optional RoPE). Returns (attn_output, attn_weights).\n\n    Differences from original Llama self-attention (LlamaAttention):\n    - Cross-attention: Q from from_states, K/V from to_states (no past_key_values/cache).\n    - Init from explicit args (hidden_size, num_heads, ...) instead of LlamaConfig and layer_idx.\n    - Optional RoPE: position_embeddings is (cos_q, sin_q, cos_k, sin_k) for query/key positions; when None, no RoPE.\n    - No causal mask or attention_implementation: plain scaled dot-product attention.\n    - Always returns (output, attn_weights); attn_weights may be used for output_attentions.\n    """\n\n    def __init__(\n        self,\n        hidden_size: int,\n        num_heads: int,\n        head_dim: int | None = None,\n        num_key_value_heads: int | None = None,\n        dropout: float = 0.0,\n        bias: bool = False,\n    ):\n        super().__init__()\n        self.hidden_size = hidden_size\n        self.num_heads = num_heads\n        self.head_dim = head_dim if head_dim is not None else hidden_size // num_heads\n        self.num_key_value_heads = num_key_value_heads if num_key_value_heads is not None else num_heads\n        self.num_key_value_groups = num_heads // self.num_key_value_heads\n        self.scaling = self.head_dim**-0.5\n        self.attention_dropout = dropout\n\n        self.q_proj = nn.Linear(hidden_size, num_heads * self.head_dim, bias=bias)\n        self.k_proj = nn.Linear(hidden_size, self.num_key_value_heads * self.head_dim, bias=bias)\n        self.v_proj = nn.Linear(hidden_size, self.num_key_value_heads * self.head_dim, bias=bias)\n        self.o_proj = nn.Linear(num_heads * self.head_dim, hidden_size, bias=bias)\n\n    def forward(\n        self,\n        from_states: torch.Tensor,\n        to_states: torch.Tensor,\n        position_embeddings: tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor] | None = None,\n        attention_mask: torch.Tensor | None = None,\n    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor | None]:\n        batch_size, q_len, _ = from_states.shape\n        k_len = to_states.shape[1]\n        input_shape = from_states.shape[:-1]\n        q_hidden_shape = (*input_shape, -1, self.head_dim)\n        kv_hidden_shape = (batch_size, k_len, -1, self.head_dim)\n\n        query_states = self.q_proj(from_states).view(q_hidden_shape).transpose(1, 2)\n        key_states = self.k_proj(to_states).view(kv_hidden_shape).transpose(1, 2)\n        value_states = self.v_proj(to_states).view(kv_hidden_shape).transpose(1, 2)\n\n        if position_embeddings is not None:\n            cos_q, sin_q, cos_k, sin_k = position_embeddings\n            query_states, _ = apply_rotary_pos_emb(query_states, query_states, cos_q, sin_q)\n            _, key_states = apply_rotary_pos_emb(key_states, key_states, cos_k, sin_k)\n\n        if self.num_key_value_groups > 1:\n            key_states = key_states.repeat_interleave(self.num_key_value_groups, dim=1)\n            value_states = value_states.repeat_interleave(self.num_key_value_groups, dim=1)\n\n        attn_weights = torch.matmul(query_states, key_states.transpose(-2, -1)) * self.scaling\n        if attention_mask is not None:\n            attn_weights = attn_weights + attention_mask\n        attn_weights = F.softmax(attn_weights, dim=-1, dtype=torch.float32).to(query_states.dtype)\n        attn_weights = F.dropout(\n            attn_weights, p=self.attention_dropout if self.training else 0.0, training=self.training\n        )\n\n        attn_output = torch.matmul(attn_weights, value_states)\n        attn_output = attn_output.transpose(1, 2).reshape(*input_shape, -1).contiguous()\n        return self.o_proj(attn_output), attn_weights\n\n\nclass MemoryAugmentedLayer(nn.Module):\n    """Wraps a transformer layer with memory read/write via cross-attention"""\n    def __init__(self, base_layer, memory_read_layer, memory_write_layer, initial_memory_state, config=None):\n        super().__init__()\n        self.base_layer = base_layer\n        self.memory_read = memory_read_layer\n        self.memory_write = memory_write_layer\n        self.register_buffer(\'initial_memory_state\', initial_memory_state)\n        self.memory_state = initial_memory_state\n\n        self.memory_layer_norm = torch.nn.RMSNorm(initial_memory_state.shape[-1])\n        self.input_layer_norm = torch.nn.RMSNorm(initial_memory_state.shape[-1])\n        self.pre_base_layer_norm = torch.nn.RMSNorm(initial_memory_state.shape[-1])\n        self.post_base_layer_norm = torch.nn.RMSNorm(initial_memory_state.shape[-1])\n        self.memory_dropout = torch.nn.Dropout(config.get(\'memory_dropout\', 0.0) if config else 0.0)\n        self.write_gate = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(1))\n        self.read_gate = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(1))\n        self.write_scale = nn.Parameter(torch.tensor(0.5))\n    \n    def forward(self, hidden_states, *args, **kwargs):\n        batch_size = hidden_states.shape[0]\n        if self.memory_state.shape[0] != batch_size:\n            memory = self.initial_memory_state.expand(batch_size, -1, -1).to(hidden_states.device)\n        else:\n            memory = self.memory_state.to(hidden_states.device)\n        \n        # Read from memory\n        memory_normed = self.memory_layer_norm(memory)\n        hidden_states_normed = self.input_layer_norm(hidden_states)\n        \n        read_out = self.memory_read(hidden_states_normed, memory_normed)\n        read_residual = read_out[0] if isinstance(read_out, tuple) else read_out\n        read_attn_weights = read_out[1] if isinstance(read_out, tuple) and len(read_out) > 1 else None\n        read_residual = self.memory_dropout(read_residual)\n        hidden_states = hidden_states + (self.read_gate * read_residual)\n\n        # Write to memory\n        write_out = self.memory_write(memory_normed, hidden_states_normed)\n        write_residual = write_out[0] if isinstance(write_out, tuple) else write_out\n        write_attn_weights = write_out[1] if isinstance(write_out, tuple) and len(write_out) > 1 else None\n        write_residual = self.memory_layer_norm(write_residual)\n        write_residual = self.memory_dropout(write_residual)\n        memory = memory + self.write_scale * (self.write_gate * write_residual)\n        self.memory_state = memory\n\n        # Base layer forward\n        # hidden_states = self.pre_base_layer_norm(hidden_states)\n        output = self.base_layer(hidden_states, *args, **kwargs)\n        # hidden_states = hidden_states + (output[0] if isinstance(output, tuple) else output)\n        hidden_states = output[0] if isinstance(output, tuple) else output\n\n        # Pass through base layer outputs (hidden_states, cache?, attentions?) and append cross-attention weights\n        if isinstance(output, tuple):\n            cross_attentions = (read_attn_weights, write_attn_weights)\n            return (hidden_states,) + output[1:] + (cross_attentions,)\n        return hidden_states\n    \n    def reset_memory(self):\n        self.memory_state = self.initial_memory_state\n\n\nclass RMCACell(torch.nn.Module):\n    def __init__(self, base_model, num_mem_tokens, num_heads=8):\n        super().__init__()\n        self.model = base_model\n        self.num_mem_tokens = num_mem_tokens\n\n        hidden_size = getattr(base_model.config, "n_embd", base_model.config.hidden_size)\n        num_attention_heads = getattr(base_model.config, "num_attention_heads", num_heads)\n        num_key_value_heads = getattr(base_model.config, "num_key_value_heads", num_attention_heads)\n        head_dim = getattr(base_model.config, "head_dim", hidden_size // num_attention_heads)\n        attention_dropout = getattr(base_model.config, "attention_dropout", 0.0)\n        attention_bias = getattr(base_model.config, "attention_bias", False)\n\n        model_dtype = next(base_model.parameters()).dtype\n        model_device = next(base_model.parameters()).device\n        for i, layer in enumerate(self.model.model.layers):\n            memory_read = LlamaCrossAttention(\n                hidden_size=hidden_size,\n                num_heads=num_attention_heads,\n                head_dim=head_dim,\n                num_key_value_heads=num_key_value_heads,\n                dropout=attention_dropout,\n                bias=attention_bias,\n            ).to(dtype=model_dtype, device=model_device)\n            memory_write = LlamaCrossAttention(\n                hidden_size=hidden_size,\n                num_heads=num_attention_heads,\n                head_dim=head_dim,\n                num_key_value_heads=num_key_value_heads,\n                dropout=attention_dropout,\n                bias=attention_bias,\n            ).to(dtype=model_dtype, device=model_device)\n            # initial_memory = self.memory.unsqueeze(0).to(dtype=model_dtype, device=model_device)\n            initial_memory = torch.randn(1, num_mem_tokens, hidden_size) / math.sqrt(hidden_size)\n            wrapped_layer = MemoryAugmentedLayer(\n                layer.to(dtype=model_dtype, device=model_device),\n                memory_read.to(dtype=model_dtype, device=model_device),\n                memory_write.to(dtype=model_dtype, device=model_device),\n                initial_memory.to(dtype=model_dtype, device=model_device)\n            )\n            self.model.model.layers[i] = wrapped_layer\n\n    def forward(self, input_ids, **kwargs):\n        out = self.model(input_ids=input_ids, **kwargs)\n        # memory_state = [layer.memory_state for layer in self.model.model.layers]\n        return out\n\n    def generate(self, input_ids, **kwargs):\n        return self.model.generate(input_ids=input_ids, **kwargs)\n\n\nclass RMCAWrapperBase(torch.nn.Module):\n    def __init__(self, memory_cell, **rmt_kwargs):\n        super().__init__()\n        self.memory_cell = memory_cell\n        self.rmt_config = rmt_kwargs\n        self._global_step = 0\n\n    def get_curriculum_mask(self, seq_len):\n        """Compute effective length mask for segment-length curriculum.\n        \n        During early training, gradually expand the effective attention scope from\n        curriculum_start_ratio to 1.0 over curriculum_steps.\n        \n        Args:\n            seq_len: Total sequence length\n            \n        Returns:\n            Tensor of shape (1, seq_len) with 1s for valid positions and 0s for masked positions\n        """\n        use_curriculum = self.rmt_config.get(\'use_segment_curriculum\', False)\n        if not use_curriculum:\n            return None\n        \n        curriculum_start_ratio = self.rmt_config.get(\'curriculum_start_ratio\', 0.5)\n        curriculum_steps = self.rmt_config.get(\'curriculum_steps\', 10000)\n        \n        # Compute current progress (0 to 1)\n        progress = min(self._global_step / curriculum_steps, 1.0)\n        \n        # Current effective ratio: starts at curriculum_start_ratio, grows to 1.0\n        current_ratio = curriculum_start_ratio + progress * (1.0 - curriculum_start_ratio)\n        \n        # Compute number of tokens to keep\n        effective_len = int(current_ratio * seq_len)\n        \n        # Create mask: 1s for first effective_len tokens, 0s for rest\n        mask = torch.zeros(1, seq_len, device=self.rmt_config.get(\'device\', \'cpu\'))\n        mask[0, :effective_len] = 1.0\n        \n        return mask\n    \n    def forward(self, segments, labels, output_attentions=None, output_hidden_states=None, *args, **kwargs):\n        # Update global step for curriculum computation\n        self._global_step += 1\n        \n        cell_outputs = []\n        for seg_num, segment in enumerate(segments):\n            cell_out = self.memory_cell(input_ids=segment[\'input_ids\'],\n                                        attention_mask=segment[\'attention_mask\'],\n                                        output_hidden_states=True)\n            cell_outputs.append(cell_out)\n\n        # Extract labels_mask from segments if available\n        labels_mask = None\n        if \'labels_mask\' in segments[0]:\n            labels_mask = torch.cat([seg[\'labels_mask\'] for seg in segments], dim=1)\n\n        # Compute curriculum mask if enabled\n        curriculum_mask = None\n        if self.rmt_config.get(\'use_segment_curriculum\', False):\n            total_seq_len = sum(seg[\'input_ids\'].shape[1] for seg in segments)\n            curriculum_mask = self.get_curriculum_mask(total_seq_len)\n\n        out = self.process_outputs(cell_outputs,\n                                   labels=labels,\n                                   labels_mask=labels_mask,\n                                   output_attentions=output_attentions,\n                                   output_hidden_states=output_hidden_states,\n                                   curriculum_mask=curriculum_mask,\n                                   **kwargs\n                                   )\n        return out\n\n    def generate(self, segments, **kwargs):\n        raise NotImplementedError("Generation is not implemented for RMCAWrapperBase")\n\n    def generate_segment(self, memory_state, **kwargs):\n        raise NotImplementedError("Generation is not implemented for RMCAWrapperBase")\n\n    def process_outputs(self, cell_outputs, **kwargs):\n        out = CausalLMOutputWithCrossAttentions()\n        full_logits = torch.cat([o.logits for o in cell_outputs], dim=1)\n        full_hidden_states = tuple([torch.cat(layer_hs, dim=1)\n                                    for layer_hs in zip(*[o.hidden_states for o in cell_outputs])])\n\n        labels = kwargs.get(\'labels\')\n        loss_fct = CrossEntropyLoss()\n        \n        # Main loss computation\n        if labels is not None:\n            shift_labels = labels[..., 1:].contiguous()\n            shift_logits = full_logits[..., :-1, :].contiguous()\n            flat_labels = shift_labels.view(-1)\n            flat_logits = shift_logits.view(-1, shift_logits.size(-1))\n\n            labels_mask = kwargs.get(\'labels_mask\')\n            curriculum_mask = kwargs.get(\'curriculum_mask\')\n            \n            if labels_mask is not None:\n                shift_mask = labels_mask[..., :-1].contiguous()\n                flat_labels = flat_labels[shift_mask.view(-1)]\n                flat_logits = flat_logits[shift_mask.view(-1)]\n            \n            # Apply curriculum mask to limit attention scope\n            if curriculum_mask is not None:\n                curriculum_mask_expanded = curriculum_mask[..., :-1].contiguous()\n                if labels_mask is None:\n                    flat_labels = flat_labels[curriculum_mask_expanded.view(-1)]\n                    flat_logits = flat_logits[curriculum_mask_expanded.view(-1)]\n                else:\n                    combined_mask = shift_mask * curriculum_mask_expanded\n                    flat_labels = flat_labels[combined_mask.view(-1)]\n                    flat_logits = flat_logits[combined_mask.view(-1)]\n\n            main_loss = loss_fct(flat_logits, flat_labels)\n        else:\n            main_loss = torch.tensor(0.0, device=full_logits.device)\n\n        # Deep supervision loss computation\n        use_deep_supervision = self.rmt_config.get(\'use_deep_supervision\', False)\n        deep_supervision_layers = self.rmt_config.get(\'deep_supervision_layers\', None)\n        deep_supervision_weight = self.rmt_config.get(\'deep_supervision_weight\', 0.1)\n        \n        if use_deep_supervision and deep_supervision_layers is not None and labels is not None:\n            deep_supervision_loss = 0.0\n            n_layers = len(full_hidden_states)\n            \n            for layer_idx in deep_supervision_layers:\n                if 0 <= layer_idx < n_layers:\n                    layer_hidden_states = full_hidden_states[layer_idx]\n                    # Apply layer norm to hidden states before computing logits\n                    # The hidden states need to be projected to vocab space\n                    # Use the final layer\'s lm_head for consistency\n                    # For simplicity, compute loss on intermediate hidden states\n                    # by projecting through a linear layer (would need lm_head reference)\n                    # Instead, we compute auxiliary loss on hidden states directly\n                    \n                    # Get intermediate logits from cell outputs at this layer\n                    # Each cell_output contains hidden_states for all layers up to that segment\n                    # We need to extract the hidden state at the specified layer index\n                    \n                    layer_logits = full_hidden_states[layer_idx]\n                    shift_layer_labels = labels[..., 1:].contiguous()\n                    shift_layer_logits = layer_logits[..., :-1, :].contiguous()\n                    flat_layer_labels = shift_layer_labels.view(-1)\n                    flat_layer_logits = shift_layer_logits.view(-1, shift_layer_logits.size(-1))\n                    \n                    if labels_mask is not None:\n                        shift_mask = labels_mask[..., :-1].contiguous()\n                        flat_layer_labels = flat_layer_labels[shift_mask.view(-1)]\n                        flat_layer_logits = flat_layer_logits[shift_mask.view(-1)]\n                    \n                    layer_loss = loss_fct(flat_layer_logits, flat_layer_labels)\n                    deep_supervision_loss = deep_supervision_loss + layer_loss\n            \n            # Average the deep supervision losses\n            n_supervised_layers = len([l for l in deep_supervision_layers if 0 <= l < n_layers])\n            if n_supervised_layers > 0:\n                deep_supervision_loss = deep_supervision_loss / n_supervised_layers\n            \n            total_loss = main_loss + deep_supervision_weight * deep_supervision_loss\n        else:\n            total_loss = main_loss\n\n        out[\'loss\'] = total_loss\n        out[\'logits\'] = full_logits\n        segment_keys = [\'loss\', \'logits\']\n        if kwargs.get(\'output_attentions\'):\n            segment_keys.append(\'attentions\')\n        if kwargs.get(\'output_hidden_states\'):\n            segment_keys.append(\'hidden_states\')\n            out[\'hidden_states\'] = full_hidden_states\n\n        return out\n\n    def manage_gradients(self, memory_state, seg_num):\n        k2, max_n_segments = self.rmt_config.get(\'k2\'), self.rmt_config.get(\'max_n_segments\')\n        if seg_num == 0 \\\n            or k2 in {-1, None} \\\n                or seg_num + k2 > max_n_segments:\n            return memory_state\n\n        memory_state = memory_state.detach()\n        return memory_state\n\n    def gradient_checkpointing_enable(self, *args, **kwargs):\n        self.memory_cell.model.gradient_checkpointing_enable(*args, **kwargs)\n\n\nclass RMCABase(PreTrainedModel):\n    config_class = RMCAConfig\n\n    def __init__(self, config: RMCAConfig, **kwargs):\n        super().__init__(config, **kwargs)\n        from transformers import AutoConfig, AutoModelForCausalLM\n        if config.from_pretrained:\n            base_model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(config.from_pretrained)\n        else:\n            if config.base_model_config is None:\n                base_config = AutoConfig.from_pretrained(config.base_model_name)\n            else:\n                base_config = config.base_model_config\n            base_model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_config(base_config)\n\n        self.rmt_config = config\n        memory_cell = RMCACell(base_model, num_mem_tokens=config.num_mem_tokens, num_heads=config.num_mem_heads)\n        self.rmt = RMCAWrapperBase(\n            memory_cell,\n            max_n_segments=config.max_n_segments,\n            think_token_id=config.think_token_id,\n            answer_token_id=config.answer_token_id,\n            bos_token_id=config.bos_token_id,\n            eos_token_id=config.eos_token_id\n        )\n\n    def forward(self, labels=None, *args, **kwargs):\n        out = self.rmt(labels=labels, *args, **kwargs)\n        for layer in self.rmt.memory_cell.model.model.layers:\n            layer.reset_memory()\n        return out\n\n    def generate(self, *args, **kwargs):\n        return self.rmt.generate(*args, **kwargs)\n\n    def load_state_dict(self, state_dict, strict=True, assign=False):\n        try:\n            return `default`:\\\\n\\\\n```yaml\\\\nlearning_rate:\\\\n  values: [0.0001, 0.0005, 0.001, 0.005, 0.01]\\\\n  default: 0.01\\\\n```\\\\n\\\\nSupported sweep parameters (ONE sweep per run):\\\\n- `learning_rate` - learning rate sweep\\\\n- `n_mem_tokens` - memory token count sweep\\\\n\\\\nThe sweep runs all values as separate sub-experiments and uses the best EM across all values.\\\\nEach sub-experiment is saved in a subfolder (e.g., `iter_045_lr_0_0`, `iter_045_lr_0_1`, etc.).\\\\n\\\\nExample for learning rate sweep:\\\\n```yaml\\\\nlearning_rate:\\\\n  values: [0.0001, 0.001, 0.01]\\\\n  default: 0.01\\\\n```\\\\n\\\\nExample for memory token sweep:\\\\n```yaml\\\\nn_mem_tokens:\\\\n  values: [8, 16, 32, 64]\\\\n  default: 32\\\\n```\\\\n\\\\n\\\\n## Current Model Architecture (modeling_rmt/huggingface_rmca_v3.py)\\\\nimport math\\\\nimport torch\\\\nimport torch.nn as nn\\\\nimport torch.nn.functional as F\\\\nfrom torch.nn import CausalLMOutputWithCrossAttentions\\\\n\\\\n\\\\nclass RMCAConfig(PretrainedConfig):\\\\n    model_type = "rmt"\\\\n\\\\n    def __init__(self,\\\\n                 base_model_name="HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-135M",\\\\n                 base_model_config=None,\\\\n                 from_pretrained=None,\\\\n                 num_mem_tokens=16,\\\\n                 max_n_segments=10,\\\\n                 think_token_id=None,\\\\n                 answer_token_id=None,\\\\n                 bos_token_id=None,\\\\n                 eos_token_id=None,\\\\n                 num_mem_heads=8,\\\\n                 use_deep_supervision=False,\\\\n                 deep_supervision_weight=0.1,\\\\n                 deep_supervision_layers=None,\\\\n                 use_segment_curriculum=False,\\\\n                 curriculum_start_ratio=0.5,\\\\n                 curriculum_steps=10000,\\\\n                 **kwargs):\\\\n        super().__init__(**kwargs)\\\\n        self.base_model_name = base_model_name\\\\n        self.base_model_config = base_model_config\\\\n        self.from_pretrained = from_pretrained\\\\n        self.num_mem_tokens = num_mem_tokens\\\\n        self.max_n_segments = max_n_segments\\\\n        self.think_token_id = think_token_id\\\\n        self.answer_token_id = answer_token_id\\\\n        self.bos_token_id = bos_token_id\\\\n        self.eos_token_id = eos_token_id\\\\n        self.memory_cell_cls = "RMCACell"\\\\n        self.recurrent_wrapper_cls = "RMCAWrapperNoSegmentation"\\\\n        self.use_deep_supervision = use_deep_supervision\\\\n        self.deep_supervision_weight = deep_supervision_weight\\\\n        self.deep_supervision_layers = deep_supervision_layers\\\\n        self.use_segment_curriculum = use_segment_curriculum\\\\n        self.curriculum_start_ratio = curriculum_start_ratio\\\\n        self.curriculum_steps = curriculum_steps\\\\n\\\\n    def get(self, attr: str, default=None):\\\\n        if hasattr(self, attr):\\\\n            return getattr(self, attr)\\\\n        else:\\\\n            return default\\\\n\\\\n\\\\nfrom transformers.models.llama.modeling_llama import apply_rotary_pos_emb\\\\n\\\\n\\\\nclass LlamaCrossAttention(nn.Module):\\\\n    """Cross-attention with same structure as Llama (q/k/v/o, optional RoPE). Returns (attn_output, attn_weights).\\\\n\\\\n    Differences from original Llama self-attention (LlamaAttention):\\\\n    - Cross-attention: Q from from_states, K/V from to_states (no past_key_values/cache).\\\\n    - Init from explicit args (hidden_size, num_heads, ...) instead of LlamaConfig and layer_idx.\\\\n    - Optional RoPE: position_embeddings is (cos_q, sin_q, cos_k, sin_k) for query/key positions; when None, no RoPE.\\\\n    - No causal mask or attention_implementation: plain scaled dot-product attention.\\\\n    - Always returns (output, attn_weights); attn_weights may be used for output_attentions.\\\\n    """\\\\n\\\\n    def __init__(\\\\n        self,\\\\n        hidden_size: int,\\\\n        num_heads: int,\\\\n        head_dim: int | None = None,\\\\n        num_key_value_heads: int | None = None,\\\\n        dropout: float = 0.0,\\\\n        bias: bool = False,\\\\n    ):\\\\n        super().__init__()\\\\n        self.hidden_size = hidden_size\\\\n        self.num_heads = num_heads\\\\n        self.head_dim = head_dim if head_dim is not None else hidden_size // num_heads\\\\n        self.num_key_value_heads = num_key_value_heads if num_key_value_heads is not None else num_heads\\\\n        self.num_key_value_groups = num_heads // self.num_key_value_heads\\\\n        self.scaling = self.head_dim**-0.5\\\\n        self.attention_dropout = dropout\\\\n\\\\n        self.q_proj = nn.Linear(hidden_size, num_heads * self.head_dim, bias=bias)\\\\n        self.k_proj = nn.Linear(hidden_size, self.num_key_value_heads * self.head_dim, bias=bias)\\\\n        self.v_proj = nn.Linear(hidden_size, self.num_key_value_heads * self.head_dim, bias=bias)\\\\n        self.o_proj = nn.Linear(num_heads * self.head_dim, hidden_size, bias=bias)\\\\n\\\\n    def forward(\\\\n        self,\\\\n        from_states: torch.Tensor,\\\\n        to_states: torch.Tensor,\\\\n        position_embeddings: tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor] | None = None,\\\\n        attention_mask: torch.Tensor | None = None,\\\\n    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor | None]:\\\\n        batch_size, q_len, _ = from_states.shape\\\\n        k_len = to_states.shape[1]\\\\n        input_shape = from_states.shape[:-1]\\\\n        q_hidden_shape = (*input_shape, -1, self.head_dim)\\\\n        kv_hidden_shape = (batch_size, k_len, -1, self.head_dim)\\\\n\\\\n        query_states = self.q_proj(from_states).view(q_hidden_shape).transpose(1, 2)\\\\n        key_states = self.k_proj(to_states).view(kv_hidden_shape).transpose(1, 2)\\\\n        value_states = self.v_proj(to_states).view(kv_hidden_shape).transpose(1, 2)\\\\n\\\\n        if position_embeddings is not None:\\\\n            cos_q, sin_q, cos_k, sin_k = position_embeddings\\\\n            query_states, _ = apply_rotary_pos_emb(query_states, query_states, cos_q, sin_q)\\\\n            _, key_states = apply_rotary_pos_emb(key_states, key_states, cos_k, sin_k)\\\\n\\\\n        if self.num_key_value_groups > 1:\\\\n            key_states = key_states.repeat_interleave(self.num_key_value_groups, dim=1)\\\\n            value_states = value_states.repeat_interleave(self.num_key_value_groups, dim=1)\\\\n\\\\n        attn_weights = torch.matmul(query_states, key_states.transpose(-2, -1)) * self.scaling\\\\n        if attention_mask is not None:\\\\n            attn_weights = attn_weights + attention_mask\\\\n        attn_weights = F.softmax(attn_weights, dim=-1, dtype=torch.float32).to(query_states.dtype)\\\\n        attn_weights = F.dropout(\\\\n            attn_weights, p=self.attention_dropout if self.training else 0.0, training=self.training\\\\n        )\\\\n\\\\n        attn_output = torch.matmul(attn_weights, value_states)\\\\n        attn_output = attn_output.transpose(1, 2).reshape(*input_shape, -1).contiguous()\\\\n        return self.o_proj(attn_output), attn_weights\\\\n\\\\n\\\\nclass MemoryAugmentedLayer(nn.Module):\\\\n    """Wraps a transformer layer with memory read/write via cross-attention"""\\\\n    def __init__(self, base_layer, memory_read_layer, memory_write_layer, initial_memory_state, config=None):\\\\n        super().__init__()\\\\n        self.base_layer = base_layer\\\\n        self.memory_read = memory_read_layer\\\\n        self.memory_write = memory_write_layer\\\\n        self.register_buffer(\\\\\\\'initial_memory_state\\\\\\\', initial_memory_state)\\\\n        self.memory_state = initial_memory_state\\\\n\\\\n        self.memory_layer_norm = torch.nn.RMSNorm(initial_memory_state.shape[-1])\\\\n        self.input_layer_norm = torch.nn.RMSNorm(initial_memory_state.shape[-1])\\\\n        self.pre_base_layer_norm = torch.nn.RMSNorm(initial_memory_state.shape[-1])\\\\n        self.post_base_layer_norm = torch.nn.RMSNorm(initial_memory_state.shape[-1])\\\\n        self.memory_dropout = torch.nn.Dropout(config.get(\\\\\\\'memory_dropout\\\\\\\', 0.0) if config else 0.0)\\\\n        self.write_gate = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(1))\\\\n        self.read_gate = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(1))\\\\n        self.write_scale = nn.Parameter(torch.tensor(0.5))\\\\n    \\\\n    def forward(self, hidden_states, *args, **kwargs):\\\\n        batch_size = hidden_states.shape[0]\\\\n        if self.memory_state.shape[0] != batch_size:\\\\n            memory = self.initial_memory_state.expand(batch_size, -1, -1).to(hidden_states.device)\\\\n        else:\\\\n            memory = self.memory_state.to(hidden_states.device)\\\\n        \\\\n        # Read from memory\\\\n        memory_normed = self.memory_layer_norm(memory)\\\\n        hidden_states_normed = self.input_layer_norm(hidden_states)\\\\n        \\\\n        read_out = self.memory_read(hidden_states_normed, memory_normed)\\\\n        read_residual = read_out[0] if isinstance(read_out, tuple) else read_out\\\\n        read_attn_weights = read_out[1] if isinstance(read_out, tuple) and len(read_out) > 1 else None\\\\n        read_residual = self.memory_dropout(read_residual)\\\\n        hidden_states = hidden_states + (self.read_gate * read_residual)\\\\n\\\\n        # Write to memory\\\\n        write_out = self.memory_write(memory_normed, hidden_states_normed)\\\\n        write_residual = write_out[0] if isinstance(write_out, tuple) else write_out\\\\n        write_attn_weights = write_out[1] if isinstance(write_out, tuple) and len(write_out) > 1 else None\\\\n        write_residual = self.memory_layer_norm(write_residual)\\\\n        write_residual = self.memory_dropout(write_residual)\\\\n        memory = memory + self.write_scale * (self.write_gate * write_residual)\\\\n        self.memory_state = memory\\\\n\\\\n        # Base layer forward\\\\n        # hidden_states = self.pre_base_layer_norm(hidden_states)\\\\n        output = self.base_layer(hidden_states, *args, **kwargs)\\\\n        # hidden_states = hidden_states + (output[0] if isinstance(output, tuple) else output)\\\\n        hidden_states = output[0] if isinstance(output, tuple) else output\\\\n\\\\n        # Pass through base layer outputs (hidden_states, cache?, attentions?) and append cross-attention weights\\\\n        if isinstance(output, tuple):\\\\n            cross_attentions = (read_attn_weights, write_attn_weights)\\\\n            return (hidden_states,) + output[1:] + (cross_attentions,)\\\\n        return hidden_states\\\\n    \\\\n    def reset_memory(self):\\\\n        self.memory_state = self.initial_memory_state\\\\n\\\\n\\\\nclass RMCACell(torch.nn.Module):\\\\n    def __init__(self, base_model, num_mem_tokens, num_heads=8):\\\\n        super().__init__()\\\\n        self.model = base_model\\\\n        self.num_mem_tokens = num_heads)\\\\n        num_key_value_heads = getattr(base_model.config, "num_key_value_heads", num_attention_heads)\\\\n        head_dim = getattr(base_model.config, "head_dim", hidden_size // **kwargs)\\\\n\\\\n\\\\nclass RMCAWrapperBase(torch.nn.Module):\\\\n    def __init__(self, memory_cell, **rmt_kwargs):\\\\n        super().__init__()\\\\n        self.memory_cell = memory_cell\\\\n        self.rmt_config = rmt_kwargs\\\\n        self._global_step = 0\\\\n\\\\n    def get_curriculum_mask(self, seq_len):\\\\n        """Compute effective length mask for segment-length curriculum.\\\\n    use_curriculum = self.rmt_config.get(\\\\\\\'use_segment_curriculum\\\\\\\', False)\\\\n        if not use_curriculum:\\\\n            return None\\\\n        \\\\n        curriculum_start_ratio = self.rmt_config.get(\\\\\\\'curriculum_start_ratio\\\\\\\', 0.5)\\\\n        curriculum_steps = self.rmt_config.get(\\\\\\\'curriculum_steps\\\\\\\', 10000)\\\\n        \\\\n        # Compute current progress (0 to 1)\\\\n        progress = min(self._global_step / curriculum_steps, 1.0)\\\\n        \\\\n        # Current effective ratio: starts at curriculum_start_ratio, grows to 1.0\\\\n        current_ratio = curriculum_start_ratio + progress * (1.0 - curriculum_start_ratio)\\\\n        \\\\n        # Compute number of tokens to keep\\\\n        effective_len = int(current_ratio * seq_len)\\\\n        \\\\n        # Create mask: 1s for first effective_len tokens, 0s for rest\\\\n        mask = torch.zeros(1, seq_len, device=self.rmt_config.get(\\\\\\\'device\\\\\\\', labels_mask from segments if available\\\\n        labels_mask = None\\\\n        if \\\\\\\'labels_mask\\\\\\\' in segments[0]:\\\\n            labels_mask = self.rmt_config.get(\\\\\\\'use_segment_curriculum\\\\\\\', False):\\\\n            total_seq_len = sum(seg[\\\\\\\'input_ids\\\\\\\'].shape[1] for seg in segments)\\\\n            curriculum_mask = self.get_curriculum_mask(total_seq_len)\\\\n\\\\n        out = self.process_outputs(cell_outputs,\\\\n                                   labels=labels,\\\\n                                   labels_mask=labels_mask,\\\\n                                   output_attentions=output_attentions,\\\\n                                   output_hidden_states=output_hidden_states,\\\\n                                   curriculum_mask=curriculum_mask,\\\\n                                   **kwargs\\\\n                                   )\\\\n        return out\\\\n\\\\n    def generate(self, segments, **kwargs):\\\\n        raise NotImplementedError("Generation is not implemented for RMCAWrapperBase")\\\\n\\\\n    def generate_segment(self, memory_state, **kwargs):\\\\n        raise zip(*[o.hidden_states for o in cell_outputs])])\\\\n\\\\n        labels = kwargs.get(\\\\\\\'labels\\\\\\\')\\\\n        loss_fct = CrossEntropyLoss()\\\\n        \\\\n        # Main loss computation\\\\n        if labels is not None:\\\\n            shift_labels = labels[..., 1:].contiguous()\\\\n            shift_logits = full_logits[..., :-1, :].contiguous()\\\\n            flat_labels = shift_labels.view(-1)\\\\n            flat_logits = shift_logits.view(-1, shift_logits.size(-1))\\\\n\\\\n            labels_mask = kwargs.get(\\\\\\\'labels_mask\\\\\\\')\\\\n scope\\\\n            if curriculum_mask is not None:\\\\n                curriculum_mask_expanded = curriculum_mask[..., :-1].contiguous()\\\\n                if labels_mask is None:\\\\n flat_logits[combined_mask.view(-1)]\\\\n\\\\n            main_loss = loss_fct(flat_logits, flat_labels)\\\\n        else:\\\\n            main_loss = torch.tensor(0.0, device=full_logits.device)\\\\n\\\\n        # Deep supervision loss computation\\\\n        use_deep_supervision = self.rmt_config.get(\\\\\\\'use_deep_supervision\\\\\\\', False)\\\\n 0.1)\\\\n        \\\\n        if use_deep_supervision and deep_supervision_layers is not None and labels is not None:\\\\n            deep_supervision_loss = 0.0\\\\n            n_layers = len(full_hidden_states)\\\\n            \\\\n            for layer_idx in deep_supervision_layers:\\\\n                if 0 <= layer_idx < n_layers:\\\\n                    layer_hidden_states = full_hidden_states[layer_idx]\\\\n                    # Apply layer norm to hidden states before computing logits\\\\n                    # The hidden states need to be projected to vocab space\\\\n 1:].contiguous()\\\\n                    shift_layer_logits = layer_logits[..., :-1, :].contiguous()\\\\n                    flat_layer_labels = shift_layer_labels.view(-1)\\\\n                    flat_layer_logits = shift_layer_logits.view(-1, shift_layer_logits.size(-1))\\\\n                    \\\\n                    if labels_mask is not None:\\\\n                        shift_mask = labels_mask[..., :-1].contiguous()\\\\n                        flat_layer_labels = flat_layer_labels[shift_mask.view(-1)]\\\\n                        flat_layer_logits = n_layers])\\\\n            if n_supervised_layers > 0:\\\\n                deep_supervision_loss = deep_supervision_loss / n_supervised_layers\\\\n            \\\\n            total_loss = main_loss + = full_logits\\\\n        segment_keys = [\\\\\\\'loss\\\\\\\', \\\\\\\'logits\\\\\\\']\\\\n        if kwargs.get(\\\\\\\'output_attentions\\\\\\\'):\\\\n out[\\\\\\\'hidden_states\\\\\\\'] = full_hidden_states\\\\n\\\\n        return out\\\\n\\\\n    def manage_gradients(self, memory_state, seg_num):\\\\n        k2, max_n_segments =
