File: huggingface_rmca_v3.py\n\n### Key Classes\n- `RMCAConfig(PretrainedConfig)` — model config, inherits from HF\n- `LlamaCrossAttention(nn.Module)` — cross-attention module (Q from one source, K/V from another)\n- `MemoryAugmentedLayer(nn.Module)` — wraps a single transformer layer with memory R/W\n- `RMCACell(nn.Module)` — wraps the full model, replaces each layer with MemoryAugmentedLayer\n- `RMCAWrapperBase(nn.Module)` — processes segments, calls RMCACell per segment\n- `RMCABase(PreTrainedModel)` — top-level HF model, resets memory after each forward\n\n### Data Flow (per sample, N=2)\n1. Context segment (2 KV pairs) → all MemoryAugmentedLayers update their memory states\n2. Query+target segment → layers read from memory, compute logits\n3. Loss computed only on target tokens\n4. Memory reset in `RMCABase.forward()` after each call\n\n### MemoryAugmentedLayer.forward() detail\n```\nmemory = layer.memory_state   # (batch, num_mem_tokens, hidden_size)\n# read\nread_residual = memory_read(input_norm, memory_norm)   # hidden updates from memory\nhidden_states = hidden_states + read_residual\n# write\nwrite_residual = memory_write(memory_norm, input_norm)  # memory updates from input\nmemory = memory + write_residual\n# base layer\noutput = base_layer(hidden_states)\n```\n\n### Config Parameters (set by trainer CLI)\n| arg          | meaning                              | default |\n|--------------|--------------------------------------|---------|\n| n_layer      | number of transformer layers         | 4       |\n| n_head       | number of attention heads            | 4       |\n| n_embd       | hidden dimension                     | 128     |\n| n_mem_tokens | number of memory tokens per layer    | 8       |\n| base_model   | backbone type: llama / gpt2 / pythia | llama   |\n| n_keys       | key length in characters             | 2       |\n| n_values     | value length in characters           | 2       |\n| n_pairs      | total KV pairs = N-level 7)\\\\nmax_context_length: 32000\\\\n\\\\n\\\\n## Repository Conventions\\\\n# Repository Conventions\\\\n(Reference document for the LLM agents — do not delete)\\\\n\\\\n## Directory Layout\\\\n```\\\\nautoresearch/\\\\n  modeling_rmt/\\\\n    huggingface_rmca_v2.py   — original RMCA (do not modify)\\\\n    huggingface_rmca_v3.py   — agent-editable copy (modified each iteration)\\\\n  run_rmca_on_kv_retrieval-v2.py   — original trainer (do not modify)\\\\n  run_rmca_on_kv_retrieval-v3.py   — trainer that imports from v3\\\\n  scripts/\\\\n    run_autoresearch_exp.sh  — short-run launcher for autoresearch\\\\n    test_rmca.sh             — quick smoke test\\\\n  data/\\\\n    N2-K2V2-V62_1M/          — N=2 dataset\\\\n    N4-K2V2-V62_1M/          — N=4 dataset (generated on first use)\\\\n  runs-autoresearch/         — raw experiment outputs\\\\n    n2/iter_000_baseline/\\\\n    n2/iter_001/\\\\n    ...\\\\n  .autoresearch/             — autoresearch infrastructure (this folder)\\\\n```\\\\n\\\\n## Model File: huggingface_rmca_v3.py\\\\n\\\\n### Key Classes\\\\n- `RMCAConfig(PretrainedConfig)` — model config, inherits from HF\\\\n- `LlamaCrossAttention(nn.Module)` — cross-attention module (Q from one source, K/V from another)\\\\n- `MemoryAugmentedLayer(nn.Module)` — wraps a single transformer layer with memory R/W\\\\n- `RMCACell(nn.Module)` — wraps the full model, replaces each layer with MemoryAugmentedLayer\\\\n- `RMCAWrapperBase(nn.Module)` — processes segments, calls RMCACell per segment\\\\n- `RMCABase(PreTrainedModel)` — top-level HF model, resets memory after each forward\\\\n\\\\n### Data Flow (per sample, N=2)\\\\n1. Context segment (2 KV pairs) → all MemoryAugmentedLayers update their memory states\\\\n2. Query+target segment → layers read from memory, compute logits\\\\n3. Loss computed only on target tokens\\\\n4. Memory reset in `RMCABase.forward()` after each call\\\\n\\\\n### MemoryAugmentedLayer.forward() detail\\\\n```\\\\nmemory = layer.memory_state   # (batch, num_mem_tokens, hidden_size)\\\\n# read\\\\nread_residual = memory_read(input_norm, memory_norm)   # hidden updates from memory\\\\nhidden_states = hidden_states + read_residual\\\\n# write\\\\nwrite_residual = memory_write(memory_norm, input_norm)  # memory updates from input\\\\nmemory = memory + write_residual\\\\n# base layer\\\\noutput = base_layer(hidden_states)\\\\n```\\\\n\\\\n### Config Parameters (set by trainer CLI)\\\\n| arg          | meaning                              | default |\\\\n|--------------|--------------------------------------|---------|\\\\n| n_layer      | number of transformer layers         | 4       |\\\\n| n_head       | number of attention heads            | 4       |\\\\n| n_embd       | hidden dimension                     | 128     |\\\\n| n_mem_tokens | number of memory tokens per layer    | 8       |\\\\n| base_model   | backbone type: llama / gpt2 / pythia | llama   |\\\\n| n_keys       | key length in characters             | 2       |\\\\n| n_values     | value length in characters           | 2       |\\\\n| n_pairs      | total KV pairs = N-level             | 2       |\\\\n\\\\n### Evaluation\\\\n- Primary metric: `eval_exact_match` — fraction of samples where all value tokens are correct\\\\n- Secondary: `eval_token_accuracy` — token-level accuracy on value tokens only\\\\n- Written to `{exp_path}/all_results.json` by `trainer.save_metrics(split=\\\\\\\'all\\\\\\\', ...)`\\\\n\\\\n## What NOT to Change\\\\n- Do not modify `RMCABase.from_pretrained()` (HF loading infrastructure)\\\\n- Do not change class names or constructor signatures of `RMCABase`, `RMCAConfig`\\\\n  (the trainer instantiates these by name)\\\\n- Do not add new CLI arguments without also updating `run_rmca_on_kv_retrieval-v3.py`\\\\n\\\\n## Naming Conventions\\\\n- New helper classes: PascalCase, suffix with purpose (e.g. `MemoryGate`, `CrossLayerSkip`)\\\\n- New nn.Module attributes in MemoryAugmentedLayer: snake_case\\\\n- Buffer names: `initial_<thing>_state` pattern\\\\n\\\\n## Hyperparameter Sweeps (experiment_config.yaml)\\\\n\\\\nTo sweep a hyperparameter, use the `values:` format with a `default`:\\\\n\\\\n```yaml\\\\nlearning_rate:\\\\n  values: [0.0001, 0.0005, 0.001, 0.005, 0.01]\\\\n  default: 0.01\\\\n```\\\\n\\\\nSupported sweep parameters (ONE sweep per run):\\\\n- `learning_rate` - learning rate sweep\\\\n- `n_mem_tokens` - memory token count sweep\\\\n\\\\nThe sweep runs all values as separate sub-experiments and uses the best EM across all values.\\\\nEach sub-experiment is saved in a subfolder (e.g., `iter_045_lr_0_0`, `iter_045_lr_0_1`, etc.).\\\\n\\\\nExample for learning rate sweep:\\\\n```yaml\\\\nlearning_rate:\\\\n  values: [0.0001, 0.001, 0.01]\\\\n  default: 0.01\\\\n```\\\\n\\\\nExample for memory token sweep:\\\\n```yaml\\\\nn_mem_tokens:\\\\n  values: [8, 16, 32, 64]\\\\n  default: 32\\\\n```\\\\n\\\\n\\\\nBased on the above, propose the next change to try (either architectural or hyperparameter, strictly following the priorities above).\\\\nIf human_directions contains pending suggestions, prioritize implementing item Memory reset in `RMCABase.forward()` after each call\n\n### MemoryAugmentedLayer.forward() detail\n```\nmemory = layer.memory_state   # (batch, num_mem_tokens, hidden_size)\n# read\nread_residual = memory_read(input_norm, memory_norm)   # hidden updates from memory\nhidden_states = hidden_states + read_residual\n# write\nwrite_residual = memory_write(memory_norm, input_norm)  # memory updates from input\nmemory = memory + write_residual\n# base layer\noutput = base_layer(hidden_states)\n```\n\n### Config Parameters (set by trainer CLI)\n| arg          | meaning ## Iter 459 | failed | N=8
- Hypothesis: Recomputing input_layer_norm after the memory read update so the write cross-attention uses post-read hidden states will allow memory to store updated representations that incorporate retrieved associations, improving EM accuracy.
- Target: modeling_rmt/huggingface_rmca_v3.py
- EM: n/a
- Success: No model improvement established.
- Weaknesses: The experiment did not reach a valid kept result.
- Failures: experiment error: Experiment script exited with code 1
- Rationale: In MemoryAugmentedLayer.forward, hidden_states_normed is computed before the read residual is applied, then reused for the write operation. This means memory writes are based on the pre-read representation, missing the information just retrieved. Recomputing the norm after the read update lets writes reflect the enriched hidden state, forming a proper read-then-write cycle essential for associative chaining.
- exp_path: /cephfs/home/bulatov/2026/autoresearch/compressing-associations-v2.9/runs/autoresearch/stream_16/n8/iter_459_fix_write_stale_norm

## Iter 445 | failed | N=8
- Hypothesis: Apply layer normalization to memory state after consolidation to stabilize memory distribution across training steps and prevent value drift that degrades associative retrieval
- Target: modeling_rmt/huggingface_rmca_v3.py
- EM: n/a
- Success: No model improvement established.
- Weaknesses: The experiment did not reach a valid kept result.
- Failures: experiment error: Experiment script exited with code 1
- Rationale: The memory state is updated each forward pass via writes and a linear consolidation layer, causing its distribution to drift over training steps. Without normalization, memory values can grow or shrink unpredictably, leading to unstable cross-attention scores and degraded gradient flow. Normalizing memory after consolidation ensures consistent magnitude, stabilizing both read and write operations across segments. The existing memory_layer_norm can be reused for this purpose.
- exp_path: /cephfs/home/bulatov/2026/autoresearch/compressing-associations-v2.9/runs/autoresearch/stream_15/n8/iter_445_memory_norm_after_consolidation

## Iter 450 | failed | N=8
- Hypothesis: Replace memory_consolidation Linear layer with per-dimension nn.Parameter initialized to zeros will fix the dimension-collapse bug that broadcasts sum(input) across all output dimensions, destroying memory information at every step
- Target: modeling_rmt/huggingface_rmca_v3.py
- EM: n/a
- Success: No model improvement established.
- Weaknesses: The experiment did not reach a valid kept result.
- Failures: experiment error: Experiment script exited with code 1
- Rationale: The memory_consolidation Linear layer with all weights 0.1 computes output[i] = 0.1 * sum(input), collapsing all dimensions to the same broadcast value. This is fundamentally destructive: it overwrites rich memory representations with a single scalar at every forward pass, before weights can adapt. All 10+ prior fixes (scaling, gating, clipping, removal) failed because none addressed this dimensional collapse. A per-dimension parameter initialized to 0.0 starts as a true no-op (adds nothing), preserving memory integrity while allowing the model to learn which dimensions benefit from consolidation. This is architecturally simpler than Linear (no matrix multiplication) and avoids the collapse-by-default behavior.
- exp_path: /cephfs/home/bulatov/2026/autoresearch/compressing-associations-v2.9/runs/autoresearch/stream_17/n8/iter_450_consolidation_param_fix
